lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn12Ni10 (reduced formula Zn6Ni5) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ni centers with 11 geometric neighbors, including Zn, while Zn centers display 11- and 12-neighbor environments, the latter forming a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ni and Zn coordination polyhedra, with the 12-vertex Zn polyhedra exhibiting corner- and face-sharing.
